en-US.title: Scaleway ControlRoom
en-US.short_description: Stop idle Scaleway servers, read their logs, see what each organization costs.
en-US.full_description:
Every hour an idle Scaleway instance runs, you pay for it. ControlRoom puts all your instances in your pocket, so stopping one takes two taps instead of a laptop.

ALL YOUR INSTANCES IN ONE LIST
Every zone, every project, running instances first, with their price per hour. Search by name or tag, or show only what is running.

START, STOP AND REBOOT
Stop the staging server you forgot, start it again when you need it, or reboot a stuck machine. Stopping asks first, so nothing goes down by accident. Turn on confirmation in Settings, and only your fingerprint, face or screen lock can stop or reboot a server.

READ THE LOGS, NOT JUST THE STATUS
The log lines of your serverless containers, functions and jobs, databases and other managed products, straight from Cockpit, with their metrics as charts: from the last 15 minutes up to 30 days. For instances, the app shows how to start sending both, with the commands ready to copy.

EVERY ORGANIZATION SIDE BY SIDE
Work for several clients or companies? Add an API key for each organization or project and see their servers, logs and costs in one app. When two keys can see the same instance, it is shown once, and costs are counted once per organization.

EVERYTHING ELSE
Databases, Redis, volumes, load balancers, IPs, domains, transactional email, secrets and more, in one searchable list grouped by type, location or project.

SEE WHAT IT COSTS
Your organization's costs so far this month, straight from Scaleway billing, with a breakdown by category and by project and the months before.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your API keys are stored encrypted on your phone, with a key that never leaves it
- The app talks only to Scaleway's own API: there is no ControlRoom server
- No account, no analytics, no tracking
- Use a key with only the permissions you want the app to have

CONTROLROOM PRO
Free: your instances, starting, stopping and rebooting them, and this month's total cost. Pro adds serverless containers, functions and jobs, every other resource, logs and metrics, cost details by category and project with the months before, and more than one API key.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, through Google Play; the price in your currency is shown in the app before you buy. It renews until you cancel it in Google Play.

TRY IT WITHOUT A KEY
The built-in demo shows the whole app with made-up servers and costs.

ControlRoom is an independent app. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Scaleway.

Privacy Policy: https://vandijkcloud.nl/Scaleway-ControlRoom/privacy.html
